description: This Java source file defines the Erf class, a utility class providing implementations of error functions (erf, erfc, inverse erf, inverse erfc) used in mathematical computations, specifically within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: Erf
classes.description: A utility class for computing error functions and their inverses, including erf, erfc, erfInv, and erfcInv, with implementations utilizing gamma functions for numerical accuracy.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Calculates the error function erf(x) using the regularized gamma function, returning values between -1 and 1, with handling for large magnitudes.

methods.name: erfc
methods.description: Calculates the complementary error function erfc(x) utilizing the regularized gamma function, returning values between 0 and 2, with handling for large magnitudes.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Calculates the difference erf(x2) - erf(x1) efficiently by choosing appropriate computation paths based on input values.

methods.name: erfInv
methods.description: Computes the inverse error function using a mathematical approximation detailed in a paper by Mike Giles.

methods.name: erfcInv
methods.description: Computes the inverse complementary error function as 1 - erfInv(x).
